column1: # Georgian (ka) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_none` in i18n/mod.rs): one form. Georgian nouns stay singular after a
# numeral (`5 გვერდი`), and fixed-count messages use count-neutral wording (`გვერდი: {n}`).
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Georgian computing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# (Acrobat's included) was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Commands are verbal nouns (შენახვა, გახსნა); Georgian has no letter case, so nothing is
# capitalised (never Mtavruli). Product and technology names (PdfCraft, PDF, Acrobat JavaScript,
# XFA ...) stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
